notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h1][b]Haberler : [/b][/h1]

Hello,

As Neuron Entertainment and Çamlıca GameLab, we have concluded that we have completed the Villa's Blinds project. Since we realized this first project; We received good feedback from various authorities, famous game developers and most importantly, you players. As we saw how solid these steps we took, we realized once again that we were on the right track. This time we continue our adventure with a brand new breath and we are proud to announce our new project to you.

Join us on our adventure...

[b]with gratitude
--
Barkın Anayurt[/b]
Founder @ Neuron Entertainment


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/b936ded04a50027ad9da9f47c912cb5459b7863d.jpg[/img]
from left to right; 3D Artist, Bartu Arda Kanber - Barkın Anayurt - Concept Artist, Ferhat Kaplan.

notes.title: News
notes.content:
[h1][b]News : [/b][/h1]

Villa's Blinds will be out of early access very soon and we will start collecting wishlists by activating the Store Page of our new project.

We are very excited about the new game! "Firearms Factory" is coming...

[b]with Gratitude
--
Barkın Anayurt[/b]

notes.title: News
notes.content:
[h1][b]News : [/b][/h1]

We sent the last update about 1.5 months ago. Of course, we[b] haven't[/b] abandoned the project.

Since we had high school education, we had to spare time for classes. With uncertain things like the date of our exams combined with the Covid process, the development process inevitably slowed down.

We've been started to continue the development process. We are planning to complete the full version of the game within the next half year by adding a lot of general mechanics.

[b]with Gratitude
--
Barkın Anayurt[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333800/Villas_Blinds/

notes.title: New Game Modes
notes.content:
[h2][b]You will need to select a game mode at the start of the game[/b].[/h2]




[h1] Hardcore Mode [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/41592f40ec2861ccc5d5aef8e2f2c102dd2e1838.png[/img]

[b]* In this game mode, you will be able to improve starting from the garage and using your limited resources. We do not recommend this game mode for players who expect good gameplay. [/b]


[h1]Normal Mode [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/1cbc2b64c7ea9edd832c5d7841a617075792f923.png[/img]


[b]* In this game mode all resources, all incomes are at normal level. The gameplay mechanics are better structured and the game will let you start in a Villa on a larger map.[/b]


* [b]The update is not yet complete. It will be active in the next update.[/b]

notes.title: Lets move to Villa!
notes.content:
[h3]Focus on To Do List and Move to Villa![/h3]


[b]We are getting a lots of feedbacks about how UI is bad.

Due to in game calendar, "the Game Adventure starts in 2005" we made the first themes very old look and cheap. Unfortunately players could'nt finish the to do list missions before they get bored about bad UI.

Players will find Villa's UI themes better for sure. Focus on To Do List and move to villa for better experience and main story line![/b]
